title: 提交之后
intent: 捕捉重要项目完成后，紧绷感缓缓退去、喜悦逐渐变得真实的片刻；轻快而不喧闹，结尾留下踏实的余韵。

tempo.feel: 轻微摇摆的四拍律动；鼓点克制，留有呼吸空间

tonality.mode: 大调，以六九和弦与大七和弦增添温暖色彩

instrumentation.name: 原声钢琴
instrumentation.role: 奏出简短、上扬的主题，并以和弦回应和变奏推动乐曲

instrumentation.name: 原声低音提琴
instrumentation.role: 由稀疏的根音逐渐转为轻盈的行进低音，结尾回归平稳

instrumentation.name: 爵士鼓
instrumentation.role: 用鼓刷和轻柔的镲片维持律动，不以加大音量制造高潮

structure.direction: 钢琴先留下一个短暂停顿，再试探性地奏出两三个音的上扬动机；低音提琴与鼓刷轻轻加入。
完整呈现明朗、易记的钢琴主题；低音与鼓建立轻微摇摆的步伐，紧绷感随和声舒展而消散。
钢琴把主题变成略带切分的短句，低音提琴轻盈行进；增加活动感，但保持音量与织体清爽。
节奏稍微放松，短暂经过较内省的和声；钢琴与低音提琴互相留白、回应，让满足感沉淀。
主题以更从容的措辞归来，旋律自然上扬后落定，不制造盛大的高潮。
鼓与低音逐渐稀疏，钢琴以温暖的延伸和弦收束，让最后的共鸣停留片刻。

production: 干净、亲近的录音室三重奏声场；保留原声乐器的自然音色、轻柔瞬态与适度动态，控制峰值，让钢琴尾音清晰延续。
avoid: 嘈杂或过于刺激的演奏
削波、爆裂杂音或数字失真
assumptions: 以约三分钟的应用时长设定为准，而非正文中的默认两分钟。
采用钢琴三重奏与轻微摇摆律动。
lyriaPrompt: An original, instrumental-only jazz piano trio piece, about three minutes long; instrumental only, no vocals. Capture the quiet realization just after submitting an important project: a few seconds of held breath, then lightness, genuine happiness, and settled satisfaction. In D major, 4/4 at about 108 BPM, with a gentle swing feel. [Intro] Let the acoustic piano pause, then offer a tentative two- or three-note rising motif; upright bass and brushed drums enter softly. [Theme] Shape that motif into a clear, buoyant melody over warm major-six-nine and major-seventh harmonies. [Variation] Give the piano lightly syncopated phrases while the bass moves into an easy walking line; keep the brushes delicate and the volume restrained. [Bridge] Relax the pulse and briefly shade the harmony inward, leaving space for piano and bass to answer each other. [Reprise] Return to the melody with more ease and quiet assurance, not a grand climax. [Outro] Thin the rhythm and settle on a warm piano chord whose resonance lingers. Clean studio recording, natural acoustic timbres, smooth transients and controlled peaks. No vocals, shouting, relentless volume buildup, clipping, crackling or digital distortion.
